cat > programs/task-80b81c09.py <<'PY'
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Decode colored lattice corners into a coarse grid of uniform-corner cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = {v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    markers = set(counts) - common
    # Lattice intersections are the rows/columns containing any non-background marker.
    ys = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for c in range(w))]
    xs = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in range(h))]
    base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for y0, y1 in zip(ys, ys[1:]):
        row = []
        for x0, x1 in zip(xs, xs[1:]):
            corners = (grid[y0][x0], grid[y0][x1], grid[y1][x0], grid[y1][x1])
            if corners[0] in markers and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
